ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious LNK Double Extension File Created
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of files with an "LNK" as a second extension. This is sometimes used by malware as a method to abuse the fact that Windows hides the "LNK" extension by default.

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("\\\.lnk$") AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\.doc\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.docx\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.jpg\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.pdf\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ppt\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.pptx\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xls\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xlsx\\\..*"))) AND  NOT (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Recent\\\\.*")) AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$")) AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\Recent\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Microsoft\\\\Excel.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Microsoft\\\\PowerPoint.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Microsoft\\\\Word.*")))
